blog_title: Lockstitch vs Chain Stitch in Bulk T-Shirts — Why a ₹18K Order Got Returned Over 1 Missing Check
caption:
₹18K order returned. One reason: missing lockstitch. 😬

Your printer checks GSM, fabric weight, color—but skips stitch type. Lockstitch locks thread both sides. One break? Seam holds. Chain stitch? One pull, entire hem unravels.

Flip any shirt. Check hem threads. Side seams = lockstitch. Takes 10 seconds.

Skip this, your batch looks local, not brand-level.

Save this post before your next bulk order 👇
